description: Add, remove, replace or edit the meals behind the user's grocery list; their ingredients go on and off the list to match, in one transaction. Send a whole plan at once with `add` (at most 21 meals, 40 ingredients each, amounts in any unit). Shared ingredients are combined where units allow. Removing a meal lowers what's needed of shared items and removes items no other meal needs, but never items added by hand; ticked items stay, marked noLongerNeeded. `replace` swaps a meal for another in one step. Returns the list like get_list plus `change` (items added and removed, estimate before and after) and `undo`: the update_meals arguments that reverse it.

quantity.description: Or free text: "2 kg", "a dozen", "2 x 227 g".

unit.description: kg, g, lb, oz, L, mL, cup, tbsp, tsp, each, dozen, can, bunch…

source.description: Where the recipe came from: a URL or a note.

maxStores.description: Shop at most this many stores (remembered; null clears it). The list is split across the set that prices the most items for the least.

near.description: Where to price the list. Remembered for next time; omit to use the last place.

preferBanners.description: Only these banners, e.g. ["no-frills", "food-basics"] (remembered; null clears it).
